- Adjustment of various visual assets
- Enemy attack strength reduced by approximately 10%
- Added supporter code confirmation window
- Added [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
- Other minor modifications and fixes

notes.title: Momon: Relic Seekers - Patch Notes 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Momon: Relic Seekers - Patch Notes 1.0.4[/h1]

- Fixed a bug related to crashing when dying in a battle against 2 or more monsters
- Fixed an error related to game over
- Fixed an error that allowed a monster to attack after the player was defeated
- Corrections to Elite Kodama's 'Weak Healing' ability
- Adjustments to Elite Kodama's 'Weak Healing' ability
- Corrections/adjustments to some Elite Kodama skills
- Corrections/adjustments to some of Kodama's skills
- Fixed scrolling speed of the Card Shop menu

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
Momon: Relic Seekers - Patch Notes 1.0.3

- Corrections to a map
- Reduced difficulty of a map
- Fixed Elite Kodama's name
- Fixed an error that caused the result of a map event to be displayed incorrectly
- Fixed an error related to the "Unexplored Ruins" event
- Fixed an error that caused some events to return with a zero value
- Fixed an error that allowed the player to have negative gold
- Fixed mouse scrolling speed in several menus and windows
- Corrections to the text in Portuguese BR
- Fixed an error related to Elite Kodama's Thorns ability
- Fixed a rare bug that caused the battle to crash after Elite Kodama used a skill
- Fixed a bug that caused the chest to appear empty on the map
